title: Barcelona in a day...
text: We were in Barcelona for two days prior to our cruise and we knew we wanted to see it all. Scheduling a tour with Sun2Spain was the BEST thing we could have done to see it all in such a short period of time. We had personal driver,Anna, and tour guide, Marta, for the entire day. Marta's expertise in the Sagrada Familia was unparalleled. Without her knowledge of all of the sites, we would have just been tourists looking at old buildings - she made Barcelona come alive to us and immediately fell in love with the city.
